note:
ISO 2026-W42 runs from October 12 through October 18. Fixed-sky highlights include Alnair. Uranus is about 4.5° in ecliptic longitude from Aldebaran in Taurus.

**Naked eye:** 🌓 First Quarter — 16:12:41 UTCα Lac — V 4 — Northern Autumn — in the Milky Wayβ PsA — V 4 — Southern AutumnGrus center — Constellation — V 3.7 — Southern AutumnLacerta center — Constellation — V 4.5 — Northern AutumnC63, NGC 7293, Helix Nebula, planetary nebula in Aquarius — V 6.5 — Finest NGC — Tropical Autumn. Moderate moonlight makes timing and local sky position important for faint targets. Use Alnair as the week’s fixed-sky framework.

**Planets:** Uranus is about 4.5° in ecliptic longitude from Aldebaran in Taurus.

**Binoculars:** Favor Alnair; wide fields help connect the charted geometry to the real sky.

**Small telescope:** Concentrate on the compact fixed-sky targets selected for the week. Increase magnification only after the target and surrounding pattern are secure.
